notes.title: Optimizations and Italian - V1.0.0.4 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Big thanks to everyone who supports Lucky Hero and gives us feedback. We noticed while many of you are enjoying the game, there are still some issues and the pacing being too slow is often mentioned. Rest assured we are working very hard to improve the game experience further!

Here is the latest patch:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44208403/9472854a557a7736e66d50445088d6f796143828.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now you can check a new window during the battle - Symbol Store Item Preview. It allows you to see what the store offers without opening the store
[*] Adjusted the difficulty for some enemies
[*] Adjusted the icon of Venomous Armor
[*] Support Italian now, credit to Daniele "Bollazza" Bolis
[*] Some bug fixes
[/list]

We are very lucky to have Daniele "Bollazza" Bolis, an enthusiastic member of the game’s community, to translate Lucky Hero into Italian. Hope Italian players will enjoy the game better!

[b]Join our Discord[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/sBRr2ytXR2]Discord[/url]

notes.content:

1. Added new function - automatic spin. After clicking the Spin at the start of a battle, the wheel will automatically spin for the remaining turns. This function is activated by default and can be closed in Settings.

2. Fixed some symbols' visual issues.

notes.title: TEST YOUR LUCK NOW! LUCKY HERO IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes!

The unique roguelike deckbuilder [b]Lucky Hero is now available on Steam! Enjoy a 10% discount for the first few days.[/b]

After a long period of demo playtest, the full version now has added new features including two new characters - Assassin and Summoner, which provide possibilities for new builds and different experiences.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Instead of cards, symbols will appear on the Wheel of Fortune to be played by you.
[*] Utilizing positional relationships between symbols, you should strategically plan your moves considering methods of changing positions.
[*] Three very different characters provide unique experiences.
[*] It is great fun pondering how to tactically choose symbols and defeat various enemies.
[*] Cute pixel art and animations.
[/list]

[b]Join our Discord[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/sBRr2ytXR2]Discord[/url]
